outcome: prevalence of tuberculosis in pregnant women
cohort: 70 pregnant women aged 18-42 years diagnosed with tuberculosis in the antenatal period at a tertiary care center
finding: The prevalence of tuberculosis in the antenatal period was 1.34/1,000 per pregnant woman and tuberculosis in pregnancy was associated with an increased incidence of preterm delivery, anemia, and intrauterine growth restriction.
birth_weight: The mean birth weight of infants born to mothers with tuberculosis was recorded (specific values not reported in abstract)
